body:
Shipped. kill-me runs as a per-app K8s Deployment on AKS, serving [workout.romaine.life](https://workout.romaine.life) from a multi-stage Docker image:

- **Stage 1 (Vite):** builds the React frontend. `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` and `BUILD_NUMBER` inlined at build time via `--build-arg`; git is unavailable in the stage, so `vite.config.js` now prefers `process.env.BUILD_NUMBER` over its git-hash fallback.
- **Stage 2 (Node):** Express serves `frontend/dist` via `express.static`, mounts the four kill-me route factories (`createWorkoutRoutes`, `createSorenessRoutes`, `createCardioRoutes`, `createAdminRoutes`), and Microsoft OAuth (`/auth/microsoft/login`) on the same origin.

## Latent bugs fixed during migration

- App Configuration key was `workout:microsoft_client_id` (colon + short name) — didn't match the `*/microsoft_oauth_client_id` filter the shared api uses to discover accepted audiences. Tokens from kill-me's own app registration would have been rejected. Renamed to `workout/microsoft_oauth_client_id` in tofu, and the new backend uses the same filter.
- App registration had zero owners (same pattern we hit on house-hunt + investing). Added kill-me's SP as owner manually + declared `owners = [data.azuread_client_config.current.object_id]` in `tofu/oauth.tf`.

## Full path

- Azure SWA + CNAME destroyed (`tofu/frontend.tf` removed)
- Image built + pushed to `romainecr` by GitHub Actions, tag committed back via `kustomize edit set image`
- ArgoCD Application in infra-bootstrap syncs `k8s/` (Deployment, Service, ServiceAccount with workload identity, Certificate, XListenerSet, HTTPRoute with dual parentRef for external-dns#5694 workaround)
- cert-manager issues Let's Encrypt via HTTP-01 on the shared `main` Gateway
- ExternalDNS creates the A record from the HTTPRoute's Gateway parent
- `snapshot.yml` trimmed to just generate + commit `snapshot.db` — the commit triggers `build-and-deploy.yml`'s `frontend/**` path filter, rebuilding the image with the new snapshot baked in and rolling the pod

## Frontend same-origin flip

- Dropped `VITE_API_URL` entirely (was falling back to `http://localhost:3000/workout`) from `api/client.js`, `auth/AuthContext.jsx`, `utils/adminMode.js`
- Deleted SWA-specific `frontend/public/staticwebapp.config.json`

## Verified

- `https://workout.romaine.life/` → 200 (React SPA shell)
- `/health` → healthy
- `/api/current-day` → real data from Cosmos (workload identity + routes wiring works)
- Unauth `POST /api/log-workout` → 401 (JWT middleware wired correctly)
- Kill-me client ID `6a7ce0ef-...` inlined into the built JS bundle

## Commits

- [6cec70a](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/commit/6cec70a) — migration
- [035ea0a](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/commit/035ea0a) — CI-committed image tag bump

## Deliberate non-changes

- `@nelsong6/kill-me-routes` npm package kept — now consumed by this repo's own backend instead of the shared api
- `/workout` mount still live on the shared api; strip on the api-repo cleanup pass (nelsong6/api#15 pattern, can extend to workout)
